iprem.name: Indicador Público de Renta de Efectos Múltiples
iprem.disclaimer: The non-lucrative rule is 400% IPREM (principal) and 100% IPREM (each family member) per month, times the authorised period. The euro figures below are the current index, not the visa statute.
iprem.periodLabel: 2023 figure, still the in-force index while budgets are prorogued

smi.name: Salario Mínimo Interprofesional
smi.disclaimer: The international-telework rule is 200% SMI per month for the holder (joint instruction applying Ley 14/2013 art. 62.3.f). How that monthly percentage maps onto the gazette’s 14-payment monthly figure versus the annual figure is not settled in the visa statute — see conflict smi-monthly-conversion.
